description: A read whose route answers with raw image/png rather than JSON: an execute hook makes the call and base64-encodes what comes back, and the handler places that text beside the client_id it was addressed by. client_id is checked by the same three rules the sibling update and delete carry, so a blank or path-bearing id answers one sentence in both languages.

cases.name: reads a non-text client_id as absent
rejects a blank client_id
cases.expect_error: client_id must be a non-empty string

cases.name: rejects a path separator in client_id
cases.expect_error: client_id must not contain path separators, query separators, or traversal segments

cases.name: rejects a traversal client_id
cases.expect_error: client_id must not contain path separators, query separators, or traversal segments

cases.name: answers with the encoded image beside the client it was asked for
reports the API failure under the declared sentence
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to get account OAuth client thumbnail 'abc123'
